x-blue.$description: X Blue — Follow buttons, link text, verified badges, active nav icons, bottom CTA accents — the only chromatic color in the system, used sparingly to mark anything interactive or trustworthy

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, button text, icon fills — the dominant readable foreground on light surfaces

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary text, metadata, timestamps, muted icon fills, helper labels

fog-gray.$description: Fog Gray — Tertiary text and disabled-state foreground

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page background, card surfaces, modal surfaces, button text on chromatic fills

mist-gray.$description: Mist Gray — Hover states, secondary surface fills, subtle dividers, input backgrounds

hairline-gray.$description: Hairline Gray — 1px border strokes separating cards, inputs, nav sections, and buttons

shadow-dust.$description: Shadow Dust — Inset shadow base for inputs and select surfaces — 3% opacity black on this tone

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Dark-mode surface fill (previews, code blocks, dim button state)

twitterchirp.$description: Primary brand typeface across all UI — feeds, nav, buttons, headings, body. The custom letterforms with ss01 stylistic set create X's distinctive voice; the tightly compressed 0.80 lineHeight on small sizes maximizes information density in the feed.

times.$description: System fallback for legacy rendering paths; not a design choice but a technical fallback that should never appear in production UI
